scenario: I am a doctor. I have five patients who will all die if they don’t get an immediate organ transplant. Another patient is just being rushed to the hospital after a serious car accident. This person is critically injured, but I can probably save him by means of a long and complicated operation. If I secretly cut his carotid artery during surgery it will cause his death and I will have the organs for the other five patients. This will kill him, but save the other five patients.
choice: I decide to obtain the organs cutting the carotid artery of the accident victim
entities: i,5 patients who need immediate organ transplants,1 accident victim being rushed to the hospital
outcomes: The accident victim loses the chance to recover from the crash injuries.
Five patients receive the needed organ transplants.
